answer: Each agent locks collateral on a public ledge, and only staked identities can submit work or vote. One concrete protocol: stake-weighted identity ledgers. A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity, multiplying cost linearly with each clone. Reputation decays toward its nadir after inactivity, so dormant puppets lose weight, while an honest agent's activity pulse keeps standing alive. Creating N sybils costs N times the stake plus forfeiture risk, making mass identity farming economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0169's threat model.
